description: Renovate maintains the GitHub Actions pins and the base images of images/: every `uses:` is pinned to a commit SHA and every `FROM` to a digest, and without something bumping them they rot silently. Base images get digest and patch updates only; a minor or major tag change also changes THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md and images/.images-allowed.txt, so it is made by hand. Python dependencies are deliberately out of Renovate's scope. Its commits are chore(deps), which the release rules in .releaserc.json do not release.

packageRules.description: Base images: digest and patch updates only.
